purpose: The MF-1 LIGHTING target's eight tools and the deterministic contrast note appended inline to each one's compact registry line. Read by scripts/build_a2t_contrast_notes.py through --targets-spec, which re-verifies the tool list against the audit receipt below before it writes an artifact. This spec is the owner's option B of 2026-09-06: KC-A1 targets the lighting cluster only, 147 of the 235 addressable rows, chosen because the five-target artifact rendered at roughly three times the program's +40-token form cap. The flight tokenizer then measured this subset at +44 tokens rather than the estimated +40, and the owner ruling recorded below settled it: the cap is advisory for a flown cell, the eight notes stand unaltered, and the token-matched control prices the form. The four remaining MF-1 targets -- activateRoutine, getBiometricData, calibrateCameras, castContent -- keep their notes in configs/knowledge/a2t-kc-a1/targets-v1.json and are NOT flown by this cell; they return per cluster later or inside the evolution loop.

owner_decision.verbatim: Option B: KC-A1 targets the LIGHTING cluster only (147 of the 235 addressable rows), so the rendered registry block stays within the +40-token form cap (section 5 of the program; the five-target inline notes were priced at about +120 tokens and are rejected on that cap). The remaining MF-1 targets (activateRoutine, getBiometricData, calibrateCameras, castContent) are NOT flown here; they return per cluster later or inside the evolution loop. KC-A1c (the length-matched category-only control) keeps the same lighting-only tool set.
owner_decision.parent_spec_note: Every note, control rule and derivation below is copied from the parent spec without one character changed; only the target LIST is narrowed, which is what keeps KC-A1 a subset of the artifact MF-1 priced rather than a rewrite of it.

note_rules.shape: The note is APPENDED to the released description on the same '- {signature}: {description}' line. Line count (152), plain tool_name sort, the absence of headers and the ASCII-only rule are unchanged; only the text after the colon grows.
note_rules.vocabulary: Every alphanumeric word of a note is either in the closed function-word list below or occurs (case-insensitively, after splitting on non-alphanumeric characters) in the registry columns -- tool_name, signature, description, domain, category, argument_constraints, argument_defaults -- of the tools of its OWN target. Nothing else may enter a note: no evaluation text, no gold call, no invented device knowledge. scripts/build_a2t_contrast_notes.py enforces this and refuses the build otherwise.
note_rules.minimum_length: Each note is at least as long as its own tool's category-only control base ('; ' + category), in TOKENS on the flight tokenizer, so KC-A1c can be grown to the SAME token count rather than truncated. A category that already measures more tokens than its note refuses the build.

control_rules.content: '; ' + the registry's own category column value for the same tool, and nothing else. No domain word, no sibling name, no scope word: the control carries the FORM of a note and none of its contrast.
control_rules.padding: Extended to exactly the treatment note's TOKEN count on the flight tokenizer (2026-09-06 owner ruling, which voids the character match this rule used to state): the neutral filler ' tool' is appended one whole token at a time until the rendered description cell 'description + control' measures exactly as many tokens as 'description + note', and a control that cannot land on that count exactly is refused rather than approximated. The rule is deterministic and re-derived by the builder against a live /tokenize route, never stored by hand; the builder additionally asserts whole-block token equality between the two arms before it writes anything. The retired character rule padded with ' tool' while it fitted and then trailing spaces, and measured 14 tokens cheaper than its treatment.
control_rules.why: KC-A1c prices the FORM of KC-A1 at the same per-line TOKEN cost with no contrast content, so KC-A1 minus KC-A1c is the content effect and KC-A1c minus the sealed baseline is the form effect. ORG-1 lost 3.23 pp at +87 tokens and +310 lines; form is the confound this control exists to measure, and a control matched on characters rather than tokens prices only part of it.

statements.token_method: MEASURED on the flight tokenizer, never estimated: the resident llama-server's /tokenize route at the cell's own serving geometry counts every rendering this receipt reports, and scripts/build_a2t_contrast_notes.py refuses --write without --tokenizer-url. The retired method was an ESTIMATE -- rendered characters divided by 3.989, ORG-1's ratio -- and it priced these notes at +40 tokens when the tokenizer says +44, which is why the 2026-09-06 owner ruling makes the measurement the authority and the +40 headroom a reported figure rather than a gate.
statements.decontamination: evaluation_query_texts is EMPTY in this build on purpose: the 4,000 evaluation rows' query text may not be read without a model-free ledger row, so the 6-gram decontamination against the evaluation roster is performed by the flight agent under its own row. Every note word is already constrained to the registry columns of its own target, which the builder enforces.
statements.manipulation: task_instruction_fill is evolved-artifact-v1 over the hash-pinned artifact {artifact}. The frozen template, the published system sentence, the 152 rows, the plain tool_name sort and the call-string output contract are the official-protocol cell's own; ONLY the description column of the MF-1 target tools differs.

getLightState.derivation: description ('Returns the current On/Off state'): this row READS and never sets, against seven setters in the same target.

resetFilterStatus.derivation: description ('filter life counter') and category maintenance against the target's lighting rows.

setAmbientLighting.derivation: domain smart_car and category media_cabin: the one non-home row of the target, and the tool 88 lighting misses reach for.

setBrightness.derivation: signature and argument_constraints ('level: [0-100]') against setLighting's state+level+color and setColor's colour arguments.

setColor.derivation: domain smart_home against setAmbientLighting's smart_car, description ('HSB') against setColorTemperature's kelvin.

setColorTemperature.derivation: argument_constraints ('kelvin: [2000-6500]') and description ('white light temperature') against setColor's HSB colour.

setGroupLightState.derivation: signature ('groupId') and description ('a group of lights') against the per-device rows.

setLighting.derivation: signature ('deviceId') against setGroupLightState's groupId; category core_control.

owner_ruling.supersedes: the greedy token-budget drop rule (B-prime) and the character-matched control
owner_ruling.verbatim: the +40 token cap is NOT a gate; the invariant the program locks is the FINAL SCORE against a form-matched control, not a token count. Fly the ORIGINAL eight-note lighting artifact exactly as measured at +44 tokens; drop NO note. The control KC-A1c is TOKEN-matched to the treatment per line on the server /tokenize, with whole-block token equality asserted by measurement. Both cells fly, sequentially, KC-A1 first and then KC-A1c REGARDLESS of KC-A1's verdict: the control is the attribution instrument, and the 'A1c only if admitted' clause is withdrawn.
owner_ruling.consequences: The eight notes and the target list are unchanged, so the treatment artifact keeps the bytes the decontamination gate passed. Only the control artifact is rebuilt, on the token rule. The +40 headroom stays a REPORTED figure for a flown cell and a SEARCH budget for the evolution loop's validator.
